title: Vietnam Trip – December 2026
summary: Planning a trip to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Originally targeting December 2026 with 3 full days, flying from RDU, staying at an upscale District 1 hotel ($160–$250+/night). February weather similar to December (dry season), slightly hotter and drier.
